shared_elements: schematic linear figures pecked/incised on a natural rock face
long straight lines crossing the surface
curved boat-like or animal-like outline forms
scattered small motifs across an open ground with no frame or register
justification: Both surfaces carry small, thinly outlined schematic motifs scattered loosely over an unbounded rock ground, with long straight strokes cutting across the field, and both appear to include a curved hull-like or quadruped-like outline. But B shows a legible repertoire of frontal human figures with raised arms and splayed limbs, a crewed boat with vertical strokes, a concentric spiral and rectilinear signs, none of which can be matched in A, whose faint linear traces show no anthropomorphs and no comparable specific motif.
